payload.text: {"summary":"Curated the geckoterminal Aomi app per aomi-app-ux-tool-maker and verified it end-to-end. The app is a 'price oracle / DEX data' archetype; the tool layer at apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs is a fully hand-curated set of 10 user-centric tools (down from 19 spec operations) backed by the app-local progenitor client (apps/geckoterminal/src/client/ — no ext/ changes needed since this platform is app-local, not shared). Tools: geckoterminal_list_networks (networks + per-network DEX ID discovery), geckoterminal_get_trending_pools (global or per-network, 5m/1h/6h/24h windows), geckoterminal_get_top_pools (network- or DEX-scoped, volume/transactions sort), geckoterminal_get_new_pools, geckoterminal_search_pools (symbol/pair/address → pool addresses), geckoterminal_get_pool (single or batched multi-address stats), geckoterminal_get_pool_ohlcv (day/hour/minute candles, USD), geckoterminal_get_pool_trades (last-24h trades with min_volume_usd whale filter), geckoterminal_get_token (composite: token profile + top pools in one call), geckoterminal_get_token_price (batch spot prices, up to 30 addresses). Dropped endpoints: /networks/{n}/tokens/multi (overlaps batch token_price), /tokens/{a}/info and /pools/{p}/info (UI metadata: descriptions, socials, images), /tokens/info_recently_updated (niche editorial feed). All list tools hydrate base_token/quote_token/dex via include= so the LLM sees symbols instead of bare relationship IDs; enum args (duration, sort, timeframe) validate with friendly error messages; the public API needs no auth so no auth.rs shim exists. PREAMBLE in lib.rs is domain-specific (role, per-tool capabilities, network-slug/JSON:API/string-number conventions, ~10 calls-min rate-limit guidance, search→pool-address workflow chaining, USD formatting rules) and is reconciled 1:1 with the shipped tool list. Verification: cargo build -p geckoterminal clean; positional args spot-checked against generated client signatures (trades and simple token_price calls line up, sensible hardcoded defaults for the 6 include_* knobs); live smoke against https://api.geckoterminal.com/api/v2/networks/base/trending_pools returned the expected JSON:API pool shape. test.json already carries the seed user_story ('Show me the trending pools on Base right now, then deep-dive the top one…') exercising trending→pool→trades, preserved as-is.","changedFiles":"apps/geckoterminal/src/tool.rs, apps/geckoterminal/src/lib.rs, apps/geckoterminal/src/client/client.rs, apps/geckoterminal/src/client/mod.rs, apps/geckoterminal/openapi.yaml, apps/geckoterminal/openapi.preprocessed.yaml, apps/geckoterminal/openapi.meta.json, apps/geckoterminal/Cargo.toml, apps/geckoterminal/test.json (entire apps/geckoterminal/ directory is new, untracked work in the working tree; no ext/ files touched — the client is app-local)","followUps":"Run /aomi-app-e2e-tester geckoterminal to expand test.json into a full multi-turn spec and run the e2e harness. Optionally smoke-chat via aomi-run apps/geckoterminal/target/debug/libgeckoterminal.dylib to sanity-check tool naming/PREAMBLE wording with a live LLM. If the free-tier ~10 calls/min rate limit bites in production, consider a CoinGecko paid-plan variant using the /onchain endpoints. If LLM context bloat from pool list responses becomes an issue, trim UI-only response fields (image_url etc.) at the spec layer and regenerate the client with aomi-build gen-client geckoterminal --force."}
